_comment: CAPABILITY suite: ONE Kafka stream publisher consuming THREE topics while FOUR are written, the messages produced as tabsdata consumes them. Functions in functions/caps_kafka_topics.py::kafka_three_of_four: its topic is a regex, ^<prefix>\.(departments|employees|dept_emp)$, which librdkafka subscribes to as a pattern; every frame lands in the one slot and is routed to its topic's table by the columns it has (kafka_departments, kafka_employees, kafka_dept_emp), anything else to kafka_unrouted. STAGES: (1) domains -- a redpanda domain with the employees model, create-model --up-to-partitions 4 creating every topic up front (departments 1 partition, employees 2, dept_emp 3, salaries 2), then the xs seed to departments, employees, dept_emp and salaries alone (--entity), its messages appended to ${xp:dir}/ops.jsonl; (2) actions, tagged live -- `produce` in the background: 8 passes 15s apart of `modify-data --entity departments,employees,dept_emp,salaries`, a fresh batch to each of the four topics, still running while (3) the collection is created and (4) the publisher registered, which STARTS it (no trigger; it reads from the earliest offset, so the seed and every pass arrive); salaries is written and not subscribed to; (5) actions -- wait for produce, then scripts/verify_kafka.py, tagged check: every message of the three topics in its table exactly once, nothing in kafka_unrouted -- a salaries message routed anywhere would be there -- polling until they arrived (at most 5m); (6) monitor. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite kafka/kafka_multi_topic_live --keep`.
